case_a_unsupported_claim.json.description: Draft claims R1 satisfied from poses and contacts only, with no checker assessment.

case_b_missing_or_wrong_evidence.json.description: Cites an evidence ID that was never retrieved, uses another execution as proof, and omits one configured object.

case_c_correct_unresolved.json.description: Honest unresolved argument that keeps uncertainty; must not be rejected.

case_d_claim_hides_checker_result.json.description: Uses the R1 checker's own synthetic fixture and its real output. The draft leaves object_00 unresolved although the checker reports a violation; the other two claims match the checker.

case_e_partial_structured_retrieval.json.description: Claims match the checker result. A Phase 5 bundle, assembled by the release's own code, left a mandatory settling-action obligation unavailable; the no-violation claim for object_01 is flagged for human review, not blocked, because the checker result supports it.
